detectors.name: malformed_or_import_fragment

detectors.name: mixed_semantic_classes_profession

detectors.name: duplicate_containment_synonym_vague_specific_and_wrong_true
detectors.review: All death candidates were gender-normalized and read as full four-option sets; lexical false positives and mere title substrings were excluded.

detectors.name: answer_leakage
detectors.review: Casterfurt vs Castel Ravello was rejected as a coincidental four-letter root match.

detectors.name: current_relation_correct_support

detectors.name: impossible_or_unsupported_medium_qualifier
detectors.review: Category-only mismatches were not automatically findings when a direct work question, an external cast override, or incomplete categorization could explain them.
